summary: Ansible 11 requires Python 3.11+ on the control node (3.10 dropped) and Python 3.8+ on targets (3.7 dropped).
questions: What Python version do I need on my control node for Ansible 11?
Can Ansible 11 manage hosts with Python 3.7?
Is Python 3.10 still supported for running Ansible?

answer_card.title: Python requirements for Ansible 11
answer_card.answer_md:
- Control node: **Python 3.11+** (3.10 no longer supported).
- Managed nodes: **Python 3.8+** (3.7 no longer supported).
